entries.en: The printer set aside the wove paper for the wedding invitations.
entries.zh: 印刷工把布纹纸留出来，用来印婚礼请柬。

entries.en: A drop of writing ink spread across the letter before I could sign it.
entries.zh: 还没等我签名，一滴墨水就在信纸上洇开了。

entries.en: He tore a page from his writing pad and handed it to the driver.
entries.zh: 他从书写纸本上撕下一页，递给了司机。

entries.en: A xerophilous plant stood in a cracked pot beside the greenhouse entrance.
entries.zh: 温室入口旁的一个裂花盆里长着一株喜旱植物。

entries.meaningZh: 地瓜〔豆薯的地区称呼，植物〕
entries.en: The yam bean vine had become tangled around the garden gate.
entries.zh: 那株地瓜的藤蔓缠住了花园的门。

entries.en: The botanist reorganized the yam family specimens before the visiting class arrived.
entries.zh: 来参观的班级到达之前，植物学家重新整理了薯蓣科标本。

entries.en: She photographed the yard grass growing through a crack in the pavement.
entries.zh: 她拍下了从人行道裂缝里长出来的牛筋草。

entries.en: A fallen sign partly concealed the yellow avens at the edge of the display.
entries.zh: 一块倒下的标牌遮住了展示区边缘的一部分水杨梅。

entries.en: We paused beside the yellow bedstraw while the photographer changed lenses.
entries.zh: 摄影师更换镜头时，我们在蓬子菜旁停了下来。

entries.en: The yellow bristlegrass brushed against his trousers as he crossed the neglected plot.
entries.zh: 他穿过那块无人照料的地时，金狗尾草擦过了他的裤腿。

entries.en: A yellow bunting landed on the gate just as I lowered my binoculars.
entries.zh: 我刚放下望远镜，一只黄鹀就落在了门上。

entries.meaningZh: 检疫黄旗〔历史航海用语〕
entries.en: In the historical drama, a yellow flag flew above the quarantined ship.
entries.zh: 在那部历史剧中，一面检疫黄旗在被隔离的船上方飘扬。

entries.en: The gardener found yellow foxtail behind the overturned wheelbarrow.
entries.zh: 园丁在翻倒的独轮车后面发现了金狗尾草。

entries.en: Rain had flattened the yellow iris beside the wooden footbridge.
entries.zh: 雨水把木制步行桥旁的黄菖蒲打倒了。

entries.en: They moved the picnic table away from the yellow locust before repairing the fence.
entries.zh: 修理围栏之前，他们把野餐桌从刺槐旁移开了。

entries.en: Her sketch of the yellow lupine was still unfinished when the class ended.
entries.zh: 下课时，她画的黄羽扇豆素描还没有完成。

entries.en: The antique fitting was made of yellow metal rather than iron.
entries.zh: 那个古董配件是用一种黄铜而不是铁制成的。

entries.en: She added a touch of yellow ocher to the dull brown background.
entries.zh: 她在暗淡的棕色背景上添了一点黄赭色。

entries.en: The cap on the yellow ochre tube was stuck, so he chose another colour.
entries.zh: 赭石黄颜料管的盖子拧不开，他便选了另一种颜色。

entries.en: A yellow oleander appeared behind the fountain in the photographer's final image.
entries.zh: 摄影师的最后一张照片里，喷泉后面有一株黄夹竹桃。

entries.en: The yellow perch swam out of sight beneath the floating leaves.
entries.zh: 那条黄鲈游到漂浮的叶片下面，不见了。

entries.en: The carpenter rejected a length of yellow pine with a deep crack along one edge.
entries.zh: 木匠弃用了一段黄松木，因为它的一侧边缘有一道深裂缝。

entries.en: The yellow rocket beside the shed survived when the old fence collapsed.
entries.zh: 旧围栏倒塌后，棚屋旁的山芥仍然活着。

entries.en: A close photograph of yellow star-thistle filled the botanist's laptop screen.
entries.zh: 植物学家的笔记本电脑屏幕上显示着一张黄星蓟的特写照片。

entries.en: We heard the yellow warbler before we spotted it above the abandoned nest.
entries.zh: 我们先听到了那只黄色林莺的声音，随后才在废弃鸟巢上方看见它。

entries.en: The yellow-bellied sapsucker disappeared behind the trunk before my camera focused.
entries.zh: 相机还没对好焦，那只黄腹吸汁啄木鸟就消失在树干后面了。

entries.en: Yellow-green algae filled the small depression beside the path.
entries.zh: 小径旁的一个小凹坑里长满了黄藻。

entries.en: A yellow-shafted flicker flew across the clearing while we packed away the telescope.
entries.zh: 我们收起望远镜时，一只金翼啄木鸟飞过了林间空地。

entries.en: The camera recorded a yellow-throated marten climbing over the fallen branch.
entries.zh: 相机拍到了一只黄喉貂爬过那根落枝。

entries.en: The fishmonger weighed the yellowfin tuna before answering the customer's question.
entries.zh: 鱼贩称完那条黄鳍金枪鱼，才回答顾客的问题。

entries.en: The herbarium's yew family collection occupied two drawers beside the entrance.
entries.zh: 植物标本馆的紫杉科藏品占了入口旁的两个抽屉。

entries.en: The young bird opened its beak when a shadow passed over the nest.
entries.zh: 一道影子掠过鸟巢时，那只幼雏张开了嘴。

entries.en: A young fish swam between the stones beneath our boat.
entries.zh: 一条幼鱼在我们船下的石头之间游动。

entries.en: The zebra finch hopped onto the empty feeder while its owner cleaned the cage.
entries.zh: 主人清理笼子时，那只斑胸草雀跳上了空食槽。

entries.en: The laboratory returned the zinc sulphate because its container had arrived damaged.
entries.zh: 实验室退回了那批硫酸锌，因为送达时容器已经损坏。

entries.en: A microscope image revealed an irregular crack in the zinc sulphide crystal.
entries.zh: 显微图像显示，那块硫化锌晶体里有一道不规则的裂纹。

entries.en: The materials laboratory received the zirconium silicate sample a week late.
entries.zh: 材料实验室晚了一周才收到那份硅酸锆样品。

entries.en: We arrived in Palo Verde just before the rental office closed.
entries.zh: 我们到达帕洛弗迪时，租赁办公室正要关门。

entries.en: The bus to Pine Knot left before I reached the station.
entries.zh: 开往派恩诺特的巴士在我到车站前就开走了。

entries.en: Her postcard from Red Bay reached us after she had returned home.
entries.zh: 她从雷德贝寄来的明信片，在她回家之后才送到我们手上。

entries.en: The student sketched a nitrite bacterium from the prepared microscope slide.
entries.zh: 学生根据制好的显微镜玻片，画了一个亚硝酸细菌。

entries.en: The pharmacist discovered that the nitrogen mustard shipment had reached the wrong department.
entries.zh: 药剂师发现，那批氮芥被送到了错误的科室。

entries.en: A damaged sensor interrupted the laboratory's measurements of nitrous acid.
entries.zh: 一个损坏的传感器中断了实验室对亚硝酸的测量。

entries.en: Condensation obscured our view of the nutrient agar inside the sealed dish.
entries.zh: 凝结的水珠挡住了视线，使我们看不清密封培养皿里的营养琼脂。

entries.en: The student compared her octadecanoic acid sample with the reference material.
entries.zh: 学生将自己的硬脂酸样品与参比材料进行了比较。

entries.en: A cracked wooden barrel had once held oleo oil in the old factory.
entries.zh: 旧工厂里的一个开裂木桶曾经装过牛软脂。

entries.en: She added a newly arrived specimen to the herbarium's olive family collection.
entries.zh: 她把一份新到的标本加入了标本馆的木犀榄科藏品中。

entries.en: The lamp's opal glass shade broke when the bookshelf fell against it.
entries.zh: 书架倒下来撞到灯时，乳白玻璃灯罩碎了。

entries.en: Even a small scratch made that piece of optical glass unsuitable for the instrument.
entries.zh: 哪怕只是小小的一道划痕，也使那块光学玻璃不再适合装在这台仪器上。

entries.en: She placed her camera bag beside the orange hawkweed and knelt to take a picture.
entries.zh: 她把相机包放在橘黄山柳菊旁，跪下来拍照。

entries.en: The chemists could not identify the organic compound in the contaminated sample.
entries.zh: 化学研究人员无法鉴定受污染样品中的那种有机化合物。

entries.en: The ceramics factory postponed the trial when its orthoboric acid delivery was delayed.
entries.zh: 硼酸迟迟没有送到，陶瓷厂便推迟了那次试验。

entries.en: During the stocktake, the warehouse staff could not locate a shipment of orthophosphoric acid.
entries.zh: 仓库工作人员在盘点时找不到一批正磷酸货物。

entries.en: The laboratory questioned the purity of the orthophosphorous acid supplied for the study.
entries.zh: 实验室对为这项研究供应的亚磷酸的纯度提出了质疑。

entries.en: The analyst found oxalic acid in the unidentified residue.
entries.zh: 分析人员在那份成分不明的残留物中检测到了草酸。

entries.en: The investigator requested an independent analysis of the unidentified oxidizing agent.
entries.zh: 调查人员要求对那种尚未鉴定的氧化剂进行独立分析。

entries.en: The chemist sent the oxybutyric acid sample to another laboratory for confirmation.
entries.zh: 化学研究人员将那份羟丁酸样品送到另一家实验室复核。

entries.en: The oyster crab in the enlarged photograph was barely visible in the original image.
entries.zh: 放大照片中的那只牡蛎豆蟹，在原图里几乎看不见。

entries.en: A painted cup leaned against the broken rim of the display pot.
entries.zh: 一株扁萼花属植物倚在展示花盆的破损盆沿上。

entries.en: The gardener moved the painted tongue away from the entrance to make room for a bench.
entries.zh: 园丁把那株蛾蝶花属植物从入口移开，腾出位置放长椅。

entries.en: A palm nut rolled out of the sack and beneath the market stall.
entries.zh: 一颗棕榈坚果从袋子里滚出来，滚到了市场货摊下面。

entries.en: The photographer's shadow fell across the palma christi before she stepped aside.
entries.zh: 摄影师让到一旁之前，她的影子正好遮住了那株蓖麻。

entries.en: The damaged parcel contained the para aminobenzoic acid ordered by the laboratory.
entries.zh: 那个受损的包裹里装着实验室订购的对氨基苯甲酸。

entries.en: Melted paraffin wax had hardened around the base of the candle.
entries.zh: 熔化的石蜡已经在蜡烛底部周围凝固了。

entries.en: The laboratory identified parainfluenza virus in the archived sample.
entries.zh: 实验室在那份存档样本中检出了副流感病毒。

entries.en: The children left their bicycles under the pecan tree while they played indoors.
entries.zh: 孩子们在屋里玩耍时，把自行车留在了那棵美国山核桃树下。

entries.en: From the upstairs window, I could see the pedunculate oak beyond the wall.
entries.zh: 从楼上的窗户，我能看见墙外的那棵英国栎。

entries.en: The supplier could not replace the missing perboric acid before the end of the project.
entries.zh: 项目结束前，供应商无法补齐缺少的过硼酸。

entries.en: A perennial pea had twined around the handle of the forgotten watering can.
entries.zh: 一株阔叶山黧豆缠住了被遗忘的浇水壶的提手。

entries.en: The phenyl salicylate crystals were photographed before the sample was sent away.
entries.zh: 那份样品送走之前，有人给其中的水杨酸苯酯晶体拍了照。

entries.en: The alchemist kept philosopher's wool in a small jar beside the balance.
entries.zh: 那位炼金术士把氧化锌放在天平旁的一个小罐子里。

entries.en: An independent laboratory detected an impurity in the phosphorous acid.
entries.zh: 一家独立实验室检测出那份亚磷酸含有一种杂质。

entries.en: Phototropic bacteria were visible near the edge of the microscope image.
entries.zh: 显微图像的边缘附近可以看见向光细菌。

entries.en: The laboratory cancelled the inspection after discovering an old container of picric acid.
entries.zh: 发现一个装有苦味酸的旧容器后，实验室取消了那次检查。

entries.en: The laboratory found a plant virus in samples from the damaged seedlings.
entries.zh: 实验室在那些受损幼苗的样本中发现了一种植物病毒。

entries.en: The assay detected plasminogen activator in the stored sample.
entries.zh: 检测发现那份储存的样本中含有纤溶酶原激活物。

entries.en: A delayed shipment of platinum black forced the laboratory to rearrange its schedule.
entries.zh: 一批铂黑迟迟未到，迫使实验室重新安排日程。

entries.en: The designer rejected the scratched panel of polymethyl methacrylate.
entries.zh: 设计师弃用了那块有划痕的聚甲基丙烯酸甲酯板。

entries.en: The new analysis detected polyoma virus in a previously untested specimen.
entries.zh: 新的分析在一份此前未经检测的标本中检出了多瘤病毒。

entries.en: The laboratory's remaining polyphosphoric acid was insufficient for the planned comparison.
entries.zh: 实验室剩余的多磷酸不足以完成原定的比较。

entries.en: The laboratory compared the damaged polyvinyl acetate film with an unused sheet.
entries.zh: 实验室将那张受损的聚醋酸乙烯酯薄膜与一张未使用的薄膜作了比较。

entries.en: The botany students borrowed the poppy family specimens for a classroom exhibition.
entries.zh: 植物学专业的学生借用了那些罂粟科标本，举办课堂展览。

entries.en: The supplier sent potassium bicarbonate instead of the material the laboratory had ordered.
entries.zh: 供应商送来的是碳酸氢钾，而不是实验室订购的材料。

entries.en: The laboratory's potassium chlorate remained untouched during the inventory inspection.
entries.zh: 盘点检查期间，实验室里的氯酸钾没有被动过。

entries.en: The missing container of potassium cyanide triggered a search of the laboratory.
entries.zh: 一个装着氰化钾的容器失踪了，引发了对实验室的搜查。

entries.en: The potassium ferrocyanide sample was too contaminated for a reliable comparison.
entries.zh: 那份亚铁氰化钾样品污染过重，无法用于可靠的比较。

entries.en: The technician found a cracked seal on the potassium iodide container.
entries.zh: 技术员发现装着碘化钾的容器封口裂了。

entries.en: The child pressed a thumb into the potter's clay and laughed at the mark.
entries.zh: 孩子把拇指按进陶土里，看着留下的印记笑了起来。

entries.en: The propylene glycol leaked from its bottle during transport, ruining the enclosed paperwork.
entries.zh: 运输中，丙二醇从瓶中漏出，毁坏了随附的文件。

entries.en: The proteolytic enzyme lost activity after the freezer failed.
entries.zh: 冰柜发生故障后，那份蛋白水解酶失去了活性。

entries.en: Traces of prussic acid were found in the laboratory's sealed waste container.
entries.zh: 实验室密封的废物容器里检出了微量氢氰酸。

entries.en: The independent analysis confirmed pteroylglutamic acid in the retained sample.
entries.zh: 独立分析确认那份留存的样品中含有叶酸。

entries.en: The lighter's worn piece of pyrophoric alloy was missing from the dismantled mechanism.
entries.zh: 打火机的内部机构拆开后，其中那小块磨损的引火合金不见了。

entries.en: The balance failed halfway through the measurements of pyrophosphoric acid.
entries.zh: 焦磷酸的称量进行到一半时，天平发生了故障。

entries.en: The instrument detected a rise in pyruvic acid during the experiment.
entries.zh: 实验过程中，仪器检测到了丙酮酸含量的上升。

entries.en: The illustrator shifted the rattlesnake plantain slightly to keep it out of the shadow.
entries.zh: 插画师把那株斑叶兰属植物稍稍挪了一下，避开阴影。

entries.en: The refrigerated parcel of recombinant protein reached the laboratory with its seal broken.
entries.zh: 那件装着重组蛋白的冷藏包裹送到实验室时，封口已经破了。

entries.en: The conservator identified red lead in paint from the old window frame.
entries.zh: 文物修复人员在旧窗框的油漆中鉴定出了铅丹。

entries.en: The red saunders stood behind the empty greenhouse in the botanist's photograph.
entries.zh: 植物学家的照片中，那棵紫檀树立在空温室后面。

entries.en: A red tide appeared in the bay during our final week of fieldwork.
entries.zh: 我们野外考察的最后一周，海湾里出现了赤潮。

entries.en: He placed a ruler beside the reindeer moss before taking a close photograph.
entries.zh: 拍特写照片前，他在石蕊旁放了一把标尺。

entries.en: A faulty freezer ruined the laboratory's last vial of restriction enzyme.
entries.zh: 一台故障冰柜毁掉了实验室最后一小瓶限制性内切酶。

entries.en: The assay showed that the restriction nuclease in the old sample was no longer active.
entries.zh: 检测表明，那份旧样品里的限制性核酸酶已经失去活性。

entries.en: The study compared reverse transcriptase from two suppliers, but neither preparation met the laboratory's requirements.
entries.zh: 这项研究比较了两家供应商的逆转录酶，但两种制剂都不符合实验室的要求。

entries.en: The ribbon worm moved beneath a loose stone in the observation tank.
entries.zh: 那条纽虫移动到了观察箱里一块松动的石头下面。

entries.en: The recovered sample contained too little ribonucleic acid for a reliable measurement.
entries.zh: 回收的样品中核糖核酸太少，无法进行可靠的测量。

entries.en: Contamination made the laboratory's analysis of ricinoleic acid inconclusive.
entries.zh: 污染使实验室对蓖麻酸的分析未能得出确切结论。

entries.en: A ring-necked snake slithered across the fallen branch and vanished beneath the leaves.
entries.zh: 一条环颈蛇爬过落枝，消失在了树叶下面。

entries.en: The old merchant lost a shipment of rock oil when the barge sank.
entries.zh: 驳船沉没时，那位老商人损失了一批石油。

entries.en: The launch was postponed because the rocket propellant had failed an inspection.
entries.zh: 火箭推进剂未通过检查，发射因此推迟了。

entries.en: Only part of the root hair was visible in the enlarged photograph.
entries.zh: 在那张放大照片上，只能看见那根根毛的一部分。

entries.en: The royal fern cast a shadow across the open pages of her sketchbook.
entries.zh: 那株王紫萁的影子落在她摊开的素描本上。

entries.en: An empty hammock hung beneath the royal poinciana beside the courtyard wall.
entries.zh: 院墙旁的凤凰木下挂着一张空吊床。

entries.en: The old rum cherry blocked our view of the cottage from the road.
entries.zh: 那棵老黑野樱树挡住了视线，使我们从路上看不到那间小屋。

entries.en: Rust inhibitor had leaked onto the workbench, leaving a sticky mark beside the vice.
entries.zh: 防锈剂漏到了工作台上，在台钳旁留下了一块黏黏的痕迹。

entries.en: The chemist requested a fresh saccharic acid sample after discovering contamination in the first one.
entries.zh: 发现第一份样品受到污染后，化学研究人员要求提供一份新的葡糖二酸样品。

entries.en: A sacred lotus filled the foreground of the painting above the staircase.
entries.zh: 楼梯上方那幅画的前景是一株莲。

entries.en: A leaking bottle of salmon oil stained the bottom of the shipping carton.
entries.zh: 一瓶漏液的鲑鱼油把运输纸箱的底部弄脏了。

entries.en: The sand lizard stood motionless while the photographer adjusted her lens.
entries.zh: 摄影师调整镜头时，那只沙地蜥蜴一动不动。

entries.en: The old bottle of sassafras oil had leaked inside the perfumer's case.
entries.zh: 装着黄樟油的旧瓶子在调香师的箱子里漏了液。

entries.en: The analysis identified a saturated fatty acid in the residue on the broken vessel.
entries.zh: 分析在破损器皿表面的残留物中鉴定出了一种饱和脂肪酸。

entries.en: The gardeners left a gap beside the saw palmetto for the new path.
entries.zh: 园丁们在那株锯叶棕旁留出了一条空隙，用来修建新小径。

entries.en: She photographed the scarlet clematis against the freshly painted garden wall.
entries.zh: 她以新粉刷的花园围墙为背景，拍下了那株深红铁线莲。

entries.en: A sea duck paddled behind the moored boat and disappeared from view.
entries.zh: 一只海鸭划水游到停泊的船后，不见了。

entries.en: The sea gooseberry drifted past the viewing window before the visitors noticed it.
entries.zh: 游客们还没注意到，那只侧腕水母就已经从观赏窗前漂过了。

entries.en: The illustrator moved her stool closer to the sea holly to examine its outline.
entries.zh: 插画师把凳子挪到离海滨刺芹更近的地方，观察它的轮廓。

entries.en: The sea milkwort was partly hidden behind the botanist's open equipment case.
entries.zh: 植物学家打开的设备箱挡住了海乳草的一部分。

entries.en: A sea onion stood beside the cracked flowerpot in the greenhouse photograph.
entries.zh: 温室的那张照片里，一个开裂的花盆旁长着一株海葱。

entries.en: He retrieved his fallen glove from beneath the seaside goldenrod.
entries.zh: 他从海滨一枝黄花下面捡回了掉落的手套。

entries.en: The researcher photographed a seed oyster beside a ruler on the inspection tray.
entries.zh: 研究人员给检查托盘上标尺旁的一只牡蛎苗拍了照。

entries.en: The new instrument gave inconsistent measurements of serum globulin in the same sample.
entries.zh: 新仪器对同一份样本中血清球蛋白的测量结果不一致。

entries.en: The veterinarian found a shaft louse while examining the hen's feathers.
entries.zh: 兽医检查那只母鸡的羽毛时，发现了一只鸡羽虱。

entries.en: The pipeline carried shale oil from the refinery to the storage tanks.
entries.zh: 那条管道把页岩油从炼油厂输送到储罐。

entries.en: He moved the pot of sheep sorrel to the other end of the table.
entries.zh: 他把盛着那种开红花的酸模的花盆挪到了桌子另一端。

entries.en: The archived specimen tested positive for Shiga bacillus.
entries.zh: 那份存档标本的志贺氏杆菌检测结果为阳性。

entries.en: A shrew mole crossed the observation box while the student adjusted the camera.
entries.zh: 学生调整相机时，一只北美鼹鼠穿过了观察箱。

entries.en: The damaged silicon carbide component was removed from the test apparatus.
entries.zh: 那个受损的碳化硅部件被从试验装置上拆了下来。

entries.en: The analysis detected silicon dioxide in the dust collected from the workshop.
entries.zh: 分析在从车间收集的粉尘中检测到了二氧化硅。

entries.en: The engineer compared the cracked silicone polymer seal with an unused replacement.
entries.zh: 工程师将开裂的硅酮聚合物密封件与一个未使用的备用件作了比较。

entries.en: A patch of silicone resin had hardened on the edge of the workbench.
entries.zh: 工作台边缘的一块硅树脂已经硬化了。

entries.en: They rested beneath the silk-cotton tree before carrying the equipment back to the truck.
entries.zh: 他们在吉贝树下休息后，才把设备搬回卡车上。

entries.en: The new silver bromide sample produced an unexpectedly poor laboratory image.
entries.zh: 那份新的溴化银样品在实验室中形成的图像出乎意料地差。

entries.en: The laboratory received silver iodide in a parcel with no return address.
entries.zh: 实验室收到了一个装着碘化银、没有寄件人地址的包裹。

entries.en: A slow loris climbed onto the branch above the keeper's empty stool.
entries.zh: 一只懒猴爬上了饲养员空凳子上方的树枝。

entries.en: Researchers suspected a slow virus, but the stored specimens provided no clear evidence.
entries.zh: 研究人员怀疑是一种慢病毒，但保存的标本没能提供明确证据。

entries.en: A broken seal made the laboratory reject the shipment of snake venom.
entries.zh: 封口破损使实验室拒收了那批蛇毒。

entries.en: The snowshoe rabbit hopped behind the fallen trunk as we approached.
entries.zh: 我们走近时，那只雪鞋兔跳到了倒下的树干后面。

entries.en: The analysis found sodium benzoate in a sealed sample of the drink.
entries.zh: 分析在一份密封的饮料样品中检测到了苯甲酸钠。

entries.en: The sack of sodium carbonate split when the warehouse shelf collapsed.
entries.zh: 仓库货架倒塌时，那袋碳酸钠破了。

entries.en: Sodium chloride crystals glittered along the rim of the evaporating dish.
entries.zh: 蒸发皿边沿的氯化钠晶体闪着光。

entries.en: The technician compared two commercial samples of sodium fluoride for the quality-control study.
entries.zh: 技术员为质量控制研究比较了两份市售氟化钠样品。

entries.en: The inspection found that the sodium hydride container had never been opened.
entries.zh: 检查发现，装着氢化钠的容器从未开封。

entries.en: The laboratory found sodium hypochlorite in the unlabelled cleaning solution.
entries.zh: 实验室在那份没有标签的清洁溶液中检测到了次氯酸钠。

entries.en: The chemists identified sodium lauryl sulfate in the damaged product sample.
entries.zh: 化学研究人员在那份受损的产品样品中鉴定出了月桂硫酸酯钠。

entries.en: The sodium sulfate crystals in the photograph had been magnified far beyond their actual size.
entries.zh: 照片中的硫酸钠晶体被放大了很多倍。

entries.en: The old photographic workshop still contained a sealed container of sodium thiosulphate.
entries.zh: 那间旧摄影工作间里仍有一个装着硫代硫酸钠的密封容器。

entries.en: A clump of soft rush concealed the photographer's dropped lens cap.
entries.zh: 一丛灯心草遮住了摄影师掉落的镜头盖。

entries.en: The gardener returned the damaged bag of soil conditioner to the supplier.
entries.zh: 园丁把那袋破损的土壤调理剂退还给了供应商。

entries.en: The sour cherry tree leaned over the low wall beside the cottage.
entries.zh: 那棵欧洲酸樱桃树斜伸到小屋旁的矮墙上方。

entries.en: The photographer waited beside the sour gum until the group had passed.
entries.zh: 摄影师在那棵多花紫树旁等候，直到那群人走过。

entries.meaningZh: 鲸油〔抹香鲸油，历史材料〕
entries.en: The museum displayed sperm oil in a sealed bottle beside an old ship's lamp.
entries.zh: 博物馆把一瓶密封的鲸油放在一盏旧船灯旁展出。

entries.en: A spider flower appeared at the edge of her unfinished garden sketch.
entries.zh: 她那幅尚未完成的花园素描的边缘画着一株醉蝶花属植物。

entries.en: The gardener moved the pot of spike moss away from the crowded doorway.
entries.zh: 园丁把那盆卷柏属植物从拥挤的门口移开了。

entries.en: We found the missing marker beside the spiked loosestrife after the survey.
entries.zh: 调查结束后，我们在千屈菜旁找到了丢失的标记牌。

entries.en: The spitting cobra remained behind the rock throughout the keeper's inspection.
entries.zh: 饲养员检查的整个过程中，那条黑颈眼镜蛇一直待在石头后面。

entries.en: The spotted salamander crawled beneath a piece of bark in the observation box.
entries.zh: 那只斑点钝口螈爬到了观察箱里的一片树皮下面。

entries.en: The night camera recorded a spotted skunk walking past the empty feeding tray.
entries.zh: 夜间相机拍到了一只斑臭鼬从空食盘旁走过。
